author: hasl
body:
Hello everyone,

So after discussing in a 'late notice' staff meeting thingy, many ideas came to rise. Also I would like to thank everyone of whom commented on Cyanide's perk post, it really got us thinking!
So as you know SG is really fun, but really empty as of late, same with CTH. So if you could have a gamemode that kept Avicus' uniqueness, what would it be? 

Be as creative as you wish, from MineZ to Quake, list your gamemode suggestions!

Disclaimer: I am not officially stating a new gamemode will be added.

Thanks,
Blizzy

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
DTC: I know another server besides OCN that has this gamemode. However, it's even more dead than Avicus. People still play on it but it doesn't go into the triple digits. There is no harm in having this, just allows me to make a more map options besides DTM and CTW.

Skywars: A lot of people loved this one. Bring it back please.

OP PVP: As Hartbeat has suggested, it could bring a lot of new players. 

Enhanced DTM: With this i mean as in like being able to create different region selections for a monument and selecting certain materials as a monument material. With this, we can create what Hartbeat calls Destroy The Base. However, this has already been implemented with OCN's advanced DTM aspects. They call it DTE or Destroy The Environment. This is one thing that I have been hoping for, for a long time now.
